purpose: DAILY-USE-BACKEND-01 J01 resurrection evidence. Each row removes exactly one configured-multi-account invariant and names the witness that must turn red. The rows cover account isolation (a second connection may not claim another's provider, credential input or discovery input), the two input-widening escapes, per-account issuance and protocol resolution, refusal of an unconfigured provider by name, and the two retained-frontend projection corrections: the provider listing is the connected set, and each model row carries the provider it is issuable through.

mutations.red: a second account claiming the primary provider was refused by the wrong guard
